the_wall_clock_start_source: the file's modification time -- AN APPROXIMATION: a phone recording carries no wall clock, and the file may have been uploaded later

the_noise_of_this_sensor.note: the change map is the corpus's own (experiments/lens.py). These are per-frame statistics over THIS recording: a recording with a lot of movement has them raised by the movement, so they are an upper bound on the noise.
